title: Final velocity after sticking
description: Essential: Correctly applies momentum conservation to find combined velocity after perfectly inelastic collision.

title: Centripetal force magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates centripetal force using combined mass and velocity from part (1).

title: Mass ratio for elastic case
description: Important: Applies momentum and kinetic energy conservation, and geometry condition, to find valid mass ratio(s).

title: Distance for inelastic series
description: Important: Derives distance as a geometric series sum from relative velocity and lap time analysis.

title: Momentum conservation setup
description: Important: Correctly writes momentum conservation equation for collisions, accounting for directions.

title: Relative velocity definition
description: Optional: Explicitly defines relative velocity with correct sign for inelastic collision coefficient e.

title: Geometric condition application
description: Optional: Correctly uses equilateral triangle vertex condition to relate velocities and distances for elastic case.

title: Sign error in relative velocity
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong sign (e.g., v_A - v_B vs. v_B - v_A) in relative velocity equation for inelastic collisions.

title: Incorrect force formula
description: Pitfall: Uses individual mass or pre-collision velocity in centripetal force formula instead of combined values.

title: Unit or algebraic slip
description: Pitfall: Makes algebraic error in solving simultaneous equations or omits units in final answers.
